scripts.check: pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:python && pnpm run build
scripts.check:python: uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ruff check tests/support && uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ruff format --check tests/support && uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ty check tests/support
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo check && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check:web: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
scripts.format: cargo fmt && oxfmt e2e playwright.config.ts package.json && pnpm run format:python
scripts.format:python: uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ruff format tests/support
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:python && pnpm run test:wasm && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:python: uv run --project tests/oracles --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests/support -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:wasm: cargo test -p qr-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib && cargo test -p qr-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --test wasm_browser
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
